title: Radioactive decay tracks seen coming off tall white suits
summary: Charles Hall tells of Radioactive decay tracks seen coming off tall white suits, about 1965 at Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So when I saw those coming off their the suits of the tall whites out in the desert, I knew perfectly well what they were.

plain: Charles Hall says that around 1965 he was stationed in Indian Springs Valley in the Nevada desert, where he met tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites. Speaking to podcast host Jesse Michels, he says he saw the tracks left by radioactive decay coming off their suits, and he knew exactly what they were. If true, it would mean the beings' suits gave off radiation.
